description: Trust framework for Education and Educational Technology (EdTech) in Sub-Saharan Africa, focusing on learning outcomes, data privacy for minors, credential integrity, and infrastructure resilience.
context_notes: Sub-Saharan Africa faces unique educational challenges: large class sizes, teacher shortages, and limited infrastructure (power/connectivity) in schools. EdTech solutions must be 'offline-first' and mobile-optimized. Trust issues include 'certificate mills' (fake degrees), predatory student lending, data privacy for children, and the relevance of curriculum to local labor markets.
